transcript.en: Dear passengers, welcome to Fitchton Railway Station.
transcript.zh: 亲爱的乘客，欢迎来到菲奇顿火车站。

transcript.en: I’m sorry to inform you that the train to London is delayed.
transcript.zh: 很遗憾地通知大家，去伦敦的火车晚点了。

transcript.en: It will take off two hours later at 11:45am. Please accept our apologies.
transcript.zh: 将于两小时后的11:45出发。请接受我们的道歉。

transcript.en: In the meantime, allow me to introduce Fitchton Railway Station, so you can make the most of your time while waiting for the train.
transcript.zh: 同时，请允许我介绍一下菲奇顿火车站，让大家在等火车的时候充分利用时间。

transcript.en: The main entrance of the station is on Fitchton Road.
transcript.zh: 车站的正门在菲奇顿路。

transcript.en: If you want to take a bike ride around here, walk down Fitchton Road and pass the taxi stop, you can find a bike rack on the right.
transcript.zh: 如果你想在这里骑自行车，沿着菲奇顿路走，经过出租车站，你可以在右边找到一个自行车架。

transcript.en: But if you just want to stay in the station, it’s OK.
transcript.zh: 但是如果你只是想留在车站，也可以。

transcript.en: You can find a luggage locker when you enter the station, it’s on the left.
transcript.zh: 进站，在左边可以找到行李寄存柜。

transcript.en: You can put your luggage there.
transcript.zh: 你可以把行李放在那里。

transcript.en: If you don’t feel very well or you need to buy some medicine, there’s a chemist’s in the farthest corner of the station, opposite to the café.
transcript.zh: 如果身体不舒服或者需要买药，在车站最远的角落，咖啡厅对面，有一家药店。

transcript.en: And, you can have a cup of coffee at the café if you want.
transcript.zh: 而且，如果你愿意，你可以在咖啡厅喝杯咖啡。

transcript.en: The big area near the café is the waiting room where you can have a seat and relax.
transcript.zh: 咖啡厅附近的大区域是候车室，可以坐下来放松一下。

transcript.en: If you want to use the toilet, make a left when you enter the station, then turn right, go straight until you walk past platform 2, it’s right there at the end.
transcript.zh: 如果要上厕所，进站左转，然后右转，直走，经过2号站台，尽头就是了。

transcript.en: The news agency is in the southeast corner of the station.
transcript.zh: 新闻处在车站东南角。

transcript.en: If you don’t want to stay in the station, you can also have a look around the station, but make sure to get back in time for the train, I’m sure you don’t want to miss it.
transcript.zh: 不想在车站逗留的话，也可以在车站附近看看，不过一定要及时赶回来坐火车，我相信大家不想错过火车。

transcript.en: The Fitchton College is within walking distance from the station, the view is quite good there.
transcript.zh: 菲奇顿学院就在车站的步行距离之内，那里的景色相当不错。

transcript.en: The town library is also just down the road if you want to read, oh, there’s also an art exhibition at the moment, you can go and check it out.
transcript.zh: 如果您想看书的话，镇图书馆也在这条路上，哦，现在还有个画展，可以去看看。

transcript.en: The store across the street opens throughout the day, and you can find all kinds of stuff there.
transcript.zh: 街对面的店全天营业，各种东西都能淘到。

transcript.en: You don’t want to buy any gifts for your friends there though, most items would be difficult to carry on a bike.
transcript.zh: 不过，建议不要在那里给你的朋友买礼物，大多数东西在自行车上都很难携带。

transcript.en: But our local food is something I recommend, it would be too late if you want them once you are on the train, you can buy some at the Foodie’s shop, which is right next to the station.
transcript.zh: 不过我推荐我们的本地食物，上车后才想吃就晚了，可以去车站旁边的吃货店买点。

transcript.en: If you are looking for anything to wear during the trip, you’d better go to the department store, but I’m afraid there isn’t enough time for that.
transcript.zh: 如果你想买旅途中穿的衣服，最好去百货商店，但恐怕时间不够。

transcript.en: You can send some postcards with local pictures on them to your friends and family.
transcript.zh: 您可以将一些带有当地图片的明信片寄给您的朋友和家人。

transcript.en: You can buy them in the community college, which is near the museum.
transcript.zh: 可以在博物馆附近的社区学院购买。

transcript.en: The old cinema behind the museum cannot compete against the new theater in the shopping center, so the current owner plans to make it an accommodation block instead.
transcript.zh: 博物馆后面的老戏院无法与购物中心的新戏院竞争，所以现在的老板打算把它改成住宿区。

transcript.en: In the back of the train station, you can see a statue of Richard Travolt, a local government minister who is famous for completing a lot of construction projects in our city.
transcript.zh: 在火车站的后面，大家可以看到理查德·特拉沃尔特的雕像，他是当地政府部长，以完成我们城市的许多建设项目而闻名。

transcript.en: Again, I’d like to remind you the train will leave at 11:45.
transcript.zh: 再次提醒大家火车11:45发车。

transcript.en: Please get back in time and I hope you enjoy your time at Fitchton...
transcript.zh: 请及时返回，希望您在菲奇顿度过愉快的时光...
